jobs.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE high fidelity, crisp, realistic, buildable web app screen for ADR Reporter, a clinical reporting application. This is a proposed UI preview, with fictional examples. Match this design system throughout: 1600x1000 landscape front-on desktop screenshot, white surfaces, pale cool gray #F6F8FB, dark navy #172B4D text, restrained blue #2563EB accent, fine gray dividers, 10px corners, little shadow, generous 24-32px spacing, consistent neutral sans serif, readable 16px body and 28px heading. Small tidy line icons, no purple, gradients, decorative charts or unnecessary cards. Sharp meaningful text, no overlapping elements or cropped controls. NOT a poster, collage, browser chrome, laptop or perspective. App shell: 200px pale sidebar, simple blue document mark and "ADR Reporter", "Demo Hospital" beneath; 56px utility header with breadcrumb, small "Demo · fictional data" label and circular initials avatar. Reporter navigation: "Overview", "New report", "My reports"; "Profile" near bottom and user "Dr. Meera S." / "Reporter". Reviewer navigation: "Overview", "Review queue", "Urgent escalations", "External submissions"; "Profile" near bottom and user "Dr. Arun K." / "Reviewer". Use only the appropriate role navigation per screen. One clear primary action per context. Distinguish data sources from human verification; green only for completed/confirmed actions and amber for missing information. Never show clinical causality judgments or invented confidence percentages. All titles and required text below should be readable and correctly spelled. Fully replace the main content for the specified page; no generic chatbot except on pages specifically requesting chat. Reporter sidebar, New report selected. Header "ADR-015" with Draft badge, saved state and subtle "Save & exit". Tabs "Chat assistant", selected "Form". Horizontal section navigation "Patient", "Reaction", "Medicines", "Reporter", "Review"; Patient selected. Only Patient section expanded, a comfortably spaced two-column form with labels "Patient initials" value "R.K.", "Age at reaction onset" value "42", adjacent age-unit select "Years", "Gender" select "Female", "Weight (kg)" optional empty field. A collapsed disclosure "Use date of birth instead". Short inline help only where useful. Right narrow plain summary: "Required details", Patient complete check, Reaction "2 missing", Medicines complete check, Reporter complete check; quiet "View sources". A slim well-fitting bottom bar "All changes saved", secondary "Back", primary "Continue to reaction". Do not render the entire long form or dozens of empty inputs at once. No approve action. Consistency requirements for every screen: all example dates must be in October 2026. Report statuses may only be Draft, Submitted, Under review, Returned for correction, Resubmitted, Approved, Externally submitted, Acknowledged. Never invent a Closed report status. Do not claim regulatory readiness, clinical validity or guaranteed AI accuracy. Any ancillary text under Export the official form must say exactly 'Download the filled PvPI form for review.' No fake unsupported account-management functions.
